title: 77% of first permit reviews took more than 30 calendar days

beats.text: How long should the first review of a building permit take?

visual.label: First review of a building permit

beats.text: In May 2025 the City announced a target of 30 calendar days from filing.
Of 127,033 finished reviews, 77 percent exceeded that benchmark.

visual.label: finished first reviews outside the later target

beats.text: The adding up is ours. This is a lead, not a finding.

visual.line: This is a lead, not a finding: a pattern in public records. This film says what the records show, what they do not show, and what would settle it.

beats.text: The City wanted 75 percent of reviews within target.
The share within the later target varies by review station.

visual.label: First reviews within target by station

beats.text: For structural plan check, 17 percent were within the target.

visual.label: First reviews within target by station

beats.text: Building plan check, 19. Planning’s zoning check, 23. The best, 43.

visual.label: First reviews within target by station

beats.text: Of 88,730 rechecks, 18 percent fell outside the 14-day target.
Some 2024 housing reviews had separate rules measured in business days.

visual.text: housing reviews measured in business days

beats.text: The share within target also varies by filing year.
